spans.s: वह् (I) vt. 10U (pres. वंहयति-ते) To make brilliant, to make bright.

वह् (II) vt. or vi. 1U (pp. ऊढ; pres. वहति-ते; pass. उह्यते; desid. विवक्षति-ते) (This is one of those roots which take two accusatives, e.g. अजां ग्रामं वहति) 1. To carry, to convey, to transport, न च हव्यं वहत्यग्निः M.iv.249, त्रिस्रोतसं वहति यो गगनप्रतिष्ठाम् Sak.vii., R.xi.10; 2. to be carried, to go, to move on; 3. to flow, e.g. परोपकाराय वहंति नद्यः; 4. to blow, वहति मलयसमीरे मदनमुपनिधाय । स्फुटति कुसुमनिकरे विरहिहृदयदलनाय Git.G.v.; 5. to marry, यदूढ्या वारणराजहार्यया K.S.v.70; 6. to take care of, to be responsible for, (तेषां) योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् Bg.ix.22, 7. to waft, to propel, अद्रेः शृंगं वहति पवनः किंस्वित् Megh.i.14; 8. to bear, to bear the load of, (त्वां) साधु मूर्ध्ना वक्ष्यत्यध्वश्रमपरिगतं सानुमानाम्रकूटः Megh.i.17, वहति भुवनश्रेणीं शेषः फणाफलकस्थिताम् Bhartr.ii.35; 9. to have, to possess, वहसि हि धनहार्यं पण्यभूतं शरीरम् Mrich.i.(The senses of this root are liable to modification according to the noun with which it is used, e.g. धुरां वह् ‘to lead the van,’ योगक्षेमं वह् ‘to look after, to take care of’ &c.)With अति-, to pass (as time).With अप-, 1. to remove, to carry off, R.xiii.22; 2. to deduct.With आ-, 1. to cause, to bring about, व्रीडमावहति मे स संप्रति व्यस्तवृत्तिरुदयोन्मुखे त्वयि R.xi.73; 2. to flow; 3. to have, to possess.With उद्-, 1. to raise, to bear up, to elevate; 2. to marry, पार्थिवोमुदवहद्रधूद्वहः R.xi.54, M.iii.8; 3. to bear, to bear the burden of; 4. to wear; 5. to possess, to have.With उप-, to bring about, to commence.With नि-, to bear up, to support, जगन्निवहते भूगोलमुद्विभ्रते Git.G. With निस्-, to be finished.With परि-, to overflow.With प्र-, 1. to draw, to carry; 2. to blow; 3. to flow; 4. to carry, to waft (as scent); 5. to bear the burden of.With वि-, to marry.With सम्-, 1. bear along; 2. to marry, to take a wife; 3. to press together; 4. to manifest, to display.

वह् Caus. (वाहयति-ते) 1. to cause to draw or carry; 2. to traverse, to go over, वाहयेदध्वशेषम् Megh.i.38.With अति-, to lead (as life).With आ-, to invoke.With निस्-, to perform, to manage, to complete.With सम्-, to press together, to rub.
वाह् vi. 1Ā (pres. वाहते) To endeavour, to make effort.
वह m. 1. Bearing, conveying; 2. the shoulder of an ox; 3. a horse; 4. air, wind; 5. a road, a way; 6. a measure of four Droṇas.
वहती f. A river, a stream.

वाह m. 1. Carrying, bearing; 2. a porter; 3. a beast of burden; 4. a horse, R.iv.56, v.37; 5. a bull; 6. a buffalo; 7. a cart, a conveyance; 8. the arm; 9. air, wind; 10. a measure equal to four Bhāras.
वहत m. 1. An ox; 2. a traveller.
वहति m. 1. Air, wind; 2. an ox; 3. a minister, an adviser.
वहती f. A river, a stream.
वहतु n. An ox.
वहन n. 1. Carrying, conveying; 2. flowing; 3. a vehicle; 4. a boat.
वाहन n. 1. Bearing, conveying; 2. a vehicle, a conveyance, Na.xxii.45; 3. a horse, तं वाहनादवनतोत्तरकायम् R.ix.60, i.48; 4. an elephant.
वहंत m. 1. Wind; 2. an infant.
वहल a. The same as बहल q.v.
वहित्र n. A raft, a boat, a vessel, विहितवहित्रचरित्रमखेदम् Git.G.i.
वहित्र n. A raft, a boat, a vessel, विहितवहित्रचरित्रमखेदम् Git.G.i.
वहिनी f. A raft, a boat, a vessel, विहितवहित्रचरित्रमखेदम् Git.G.i.
वाहिनी f. 1. An army in general, पश्चादवस्थापितवाहिनीकः R.xiii.66; 2. a detachment of an army consisting of 81 elephants, as many cars, 243 horse, and 405 foot; 3. a river.
वहिस् ind. The same as बहिस् q.v.
वहिष्क a. (f. ष्का) Outer, external.
वहिष्क a. (f. ष्का) Outer, external.
वहेडुक m. The Bibhītaka tree.
वह्नि m. 1. Fire, सुरसरिदिव तेजो वह्निनिष्ठ्यूतमैशम् R.ii.75; 2. the digestive faculty; 3. digestion, appetite.
वह्नि-काष्ठ n. a kind, of agallochum.
वह्नि-गंध m. incense.
वह्नि-गर्भ m. 1. a bamboo; 2. the Śamī tree.
वह्नि-दीपक m. safflower.
वह्नि-भोग्य n. clarified butter.
वह्नि-मित्र m. air, wind.
वह्नि-रेतस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
वह्नि-लोह, -लोहक n. copper.
वह्नि-लोह, -लोहक n. copper.
वह्नि-वर्ण n. the red water-lily.
वह्नि-वल्लभ m. resin.
वह्नि-बीज n. 1. gold; 2. the common lime.
वह्नि-शिख m. 1. saffron; 2. safflower.
वह्नि-सख m. the wind.
वह्य n. 1. A carriage; 2. a vehicle in general.
वाह्य a. the same as बाह्य q.v.
वह्लिक m. pl. See बह्लिक, बह्लीक.
वह्लिक m. pl. See बह्लिक, बह्लीक.
वाह्लि(ह्ली)क (I) m. 1. Name of the country now called Balkh; 2. a Balkh-bred horse.
वाह्लि(ह्ली)क (II) n. 1. Saffron; 2. asa fœtida.
वाह्लि(ह्ली)क (I) m. 1. Name of the country now called Balkh; 2. a Balkh-bred horse.
वाह्लि(ह्ली)क (II) n. 1. Saffron; 2. asa fœtida.
वाह-द्विषत् m. a buffalo.
वाह-श्रेष्ठ m. a horse.
वाहक m. 1. A porter; 2. a horseman.
वाहस m. 1. A large snake; 2. a water-course.
वाहिक m. 1. A large drum; 2. a vehicle drawn by oxen.
वाहीक m. The same as बाहीक q.v.
वाहित n. A heavy burden.
वाहिन् m. A chariot.
वाहित्त्थ n. the part of an elephant’s forehead below the frontal globes.
वाहिनी-निवेश m. the camp of an army.
वाहिनी-पति m. 1. a commanding officer; 2. the ocean.
वाहुक m. the same as बाहुक q.v.
वाह्लि f. Name of a country now known as Balkh.
वाह्लि-ज m. a Balkh-bred horse.
